description: An agent updates the components of the project to match one Figma frame, and your check proves the change. You keep the change or drop it.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.label: Figma frame
inputs.description: A link to the frame, or its node id, for example 12:34.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves the change, for example the tests.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What the agent reports it changed.

nodes.label: Not a frame
nodes.message: Give a link to a Figma frame, or a node id such as 12:34.

nodes.label: Update the components
nodes.prompt:
Make the components of this project match a Figma frame. Figma gave this design context for the frame {{node_id.data.id}}:

{{design.text}}

The code in it is a reference, not code to paste. Find the components of the project that the frame shows, and update their layout, spacing, colors, type and text. Use the project's own components, design tokens and styles. Add a component only when the project has none for a part of the frame. Do not change what the frame does not show.

When you are done, `{{check}}` must pass. Run it yourself before you report. When you cannot make it pass, report `fail`. Do not commit: a person looks at the change first. In your summary, name each component you changed and what changed. Nobody is awake: do not ask a question, decide.

nodes.label: Keep the change?
Commit
nodes.command:
set -e
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
	echo 'Nothing changed.'
	exit 0
fi
git commit -m "figma-to-code: frame {{node_id.data.id}}" -m "{{frame}}" -m "{{update.summary}}"

nodes.label: Dropped
nodes.message: You dropped the change. Nothing is committed.
